projects.title: Forest Dependence, Management and Ecological Identity: Exploring Interlinkages in Western Indian Himalayan Region
projects.description: My work explores the interlinkages between forest dependence, forest management, and ecological identity in the Western Indian Himalayan Region (WIHR). In this context, I am trying to understand the reasons and effects of the differences in stakeholders' perceptions. Alongside, the work aims to examine the issue of community participation in Indian forest management.
